title: The Weekend - Going To The Playground
audio: mp3/335. The Weekend - Going To The Playground.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 Englishpod。 我的名字是马可。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and we're going to have some fun today, Marco, right?
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，我们今天要找点乐子，马可，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we are taking a small kid and we're going to the park and we're going to play.
segments.zh: 今天我们要带一个小孩，我们要去公园，我们要去玩。

segments.en: Okay, so there are fun things you can do at the park.
segments.zh: 好的，所以你可以在公园里做一些有趣的事情。

segments.en: We're going to learn all about them.
segments.zh: 我们将了解它们的所有信息。

segments.en: Let's take a listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 我们来听听对话。

segments.en: Hey, honey.
segments.zh: 嘿，亲爱的。

segments.en: Where were you?
segments.zh: 你去哪儿了？

segments.en: I decided to take Kenny to the park and get some fresh air.
segments.zh: 我带肯尼去公园透透气。

segments.en: How was it?
segments.zh: 怎么样？

segments.en: Were there a lot of kids?
segments.zh: 有很多孩子吗？

segments.en: It wasn't too crowded, but we had a great time.
segments.zh: 人不算多，不过我们玩得挺开心。

segments.en: We got on the seesaw together, then went on a couple of different slides, and then I tried to go with him in the jungle gym, but I didn't fit.
segments.zh: 我们一起玩了跷跷板，还玩了几种滑梯。我本想跟他一起钻攀爬架，可是身子太大，进不去。

segments.en: Sounds like fun.
segments.zh: 听起来挺好玩。

segments.en: When we go, he always just likes to play in the sandbox.
segments.zh: 我带他去时，他总是只爱在沙坑里玩。

segments.en: Yeah, but today he was really hyper.
segments.zh: 是啊，不过他今天特别兴奋。

segments.en: He even got onto the monkey bars.
segments.zh: 他连攀爬横梯都玩了。

segments.en: And then he went on to go on the swings for half an hour.
segments.zh: 后来他又荡了半个小时秋千。

segments.en: I'm exhausted.
segments.zh: 我筋疲力尽。

segments.en: You should go to the park more often since you don't go to the gym anymore.
segments.zh: 你现在都不去健身房了，倒该多带他去公园活动。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now let's take a look at some of this great playground equipment on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在，我们在语言要点环节来看看这些很棒的游乐设备。

segments.en: So, as you said, Marco, today we're focusing in Language Takeaway on some of these things you can do at the park.
segments.zh: 所以，正如你所说，马可，今天我们语言要点环节的重点是你在公园里能做的一些事情。

segments.en: Now, the first one is one of my personal favorites from childhood called the seesaw.
segments.zh: 现在，第一个是我个人最喜欢的，叫做跷跷板。

segments.en: The seesaw, that's right. And so basically it's that long piece of, well, sometimes metal or wood, and two people sit at each opposite end.
segments.zh: 跷跷板，没错。 所以基本上它是一块长长的，嗯，有时是金属或木头，两端都坐着两个人。

segments.en: Yes, and so when one person goes down, the other person goes up.
segments.zh: 是的，所以当一个人降下去时，另一个人就升上来。

segments.en: And when that person goes down, the other person goes up.
segments.zh: 当那个人降下去时，另一个人就升上来。

segments.en: So it's a seesaw.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个跷跷板。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So yes, it's actually a very common toy that you can play with at the playground.
segments.zh: 所以是的，它实际上是一个非常常见的玩具，你可以在操场上玩。

segments.en: But also another very common one I'm sure everyone knows and has been on is a slide.
segments.zh: 不过我相信大家都很熟悉、也都玩过的另一种很常见的设施，就是滑梯。

segments.en: A slide.
segments.zh: 滑梯。

segments.en: Now this is a bit hard to describe actually.
segments.zh: 现在这实际上有点难以描述。

segments.en: Slides are usually quite colorful.
segments.zh: 滑梯通常色彩很丰富。

segments.en: But they're like tubes that are open and the child can go down.
segments.zh: 但它们就像开口的管子，孩子可以顺着滑下去。

segments.en: So you're on top, maybe two meters high, and then you go down the slide and you come down to the ground.
segments.zh: 所以你在顶部，可能有两米高，然后你顺着滑梯往下滑，落到地面上。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And actually it's the noun, a slide, but what you do is, the verb is you actually slide down the slide.
segments.zh: 实际上它是名词，滑梯，但你所做的是，动词是你实际上是滑下滑梯。

segments.en: Yes, and sometimes you go very fast and it's scary.
segments.zh: 是的，有时你走得很快，这很可怕。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And well, if you want to have something a little bit less scary, you can go into the jungle gym.
segments.zh: 好吧，如果你想有一些不那么可怕的东西，你可以去丛林健身房。

segments.en: All right, jungle.
segments.zh: 好吧，丛林。

segments.en: Now the jungle is actually a place.
segments.zh: 现在丛林实际上是一个地方。

segments.en: In South America, for example, you have jungles with lots of trees and monkeys and everything.
segments.zh: 例如，在南美洲，你有很多树木和猴子的丛林等等。

segments.en: But jungle gym is like many, many different metal bars or wood together to make this open structure that boys and girls can climb on.
segments.zh: 但丛林健身房就像许多不同的金属条或木头一起构成了男孩和女孩可以攀登的开放式结构。

segments.en: So basically you start on the ground and you climb all the way up it.
segments.zh: 所以基本上你从地面开始，你一直爬上去。

segments.en: Okay, so I think this is why it's called a kind of like a jungle gym, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我认为这就是为什么它被称为丛林健身房的原因，对吧？

segments.en: Because you can climb up and down and grab all these bars.
segments.zh: 因为你可以上下爬，抓住所有这些横杆。

segments.en: You can hang like a monkey from the bars.
segments.zh: 你可以像猴子一样挂在横杆上。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Yeah, so basically it's just a cage that boys and girls can climb on and play with.
segments.zh: 是的，所以基本上它只是一个男孩和女孩可以爬上和玩耍的笼子。

segments.en: Right, and I guess you call it a jungle gym because when you're doing all this, you're doing exercise.
segments.zh: 是的，我猜你称之为丛林健身房，因为当你做这一切时，你就是在锻炼。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right, so now maybe for the smaller kids who just want to play with some toys, they can just hang out at the sandbox.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以现在也许对于那些只想玩一些玩具的小孩来说，他们可以在沙箱里闲逛。

segments.en: All right, this is one word, but it's actually quite literal.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一个词，但它实际上是相当字面的。

segments.en: You'd have sand in a box.
segments.zh: 你会在一个盒子里有沙子。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And a sandbox is very safe and very fun because boys and girls can make castles or dig, but there's nothing to it really.
segments.zh: 沙盒非常安全且非常有趣，因为男孩和女孩可以制作城堡或挖掘，但它其实没什么特别的。

segments.en: It's just a box.
segments.zh: 它只是一个盒子。

segments.en: It's just a box with sand, literally.
segments.zh: 从字面上看，它只是一个有沙子的盒子。

segments.en: Yes, that's right.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So that's also fun for the smaller kids to be at the sandbox.
segments.zh: 所以对于较小的孩子来说，在沙箱里也很有趣。

segments.en: Now, going back to something very similar to the jungle gym, we have the monkey bars.
segments.zh: 现在，回到与丛林健身房非常相似的地方，我们有攀爬横梯。

segments.en: Okay, now monkey bars are a very important part of the park.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在攀爬横梯是公园里非常重要的一部分。

segments.en: These are horizontal bars, so they're across.
segments.zh: 这些是水平条，所以它们是跨越的。

segments.en: And you hang on them with your arms, so your body hangs down.
segments.zh: 你用手臂挂在它们上，所以你的身体垂下。

segments.en: And when you hang, your feet are off the ground.
segments.zh: 当你悬挂时，你的脚已经离开了地面。

segments.en: It's very tall.
segments.zh: 它非常高。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And you have to move.
segments.zh: 而且你必须往前移动。

segments.en: You have to change from one bar to the other.
segments.zh: 你必须从一根横杆换到另一根横杆。

segments.en: So it's like a ladder that you're pulling yourself across.
segments.zh: 所以它就像一个梯子，你把自己拉过来。

segments.en: Yes, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: So you've probably seen it exactly how you describe it. It's a ladder, and you just got to hang on to the different bars with your arms.
segments.zh: 所以你可能已经见过，完全就像你描述的那样。 这是一架梯子，你只要用手臂抓住一根根横杆。

segments.en: It's actually quite difficult to do.
segments.zh: 其实很难做到。

segments.en: I always used to get upset because I couldn't go all the way across because you go from one end to the other end.
segments.zh: 我总是很生气，因为我不能一路穿越，因为你从一端走到另一端。

segments.en: But my arms would get so tired that I had to drop down onto the ground.
segments.zh: 但我的手臂会累得不行，我不得不松手落到地面上。

segments.en: Really? All right. Well, something that's a little bit less exhausting but also very fun are when you go on the swings.
segments.zh: 真的吗？ 好的。 好吧，还有一种不那么累但也很好玩的活动，就是荡秋千。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Swings are great.
segments.zh: 秋千很棒。

segments.en: Now, swings are kind of like chairs, but they don't have a back.
segments.zh: 现在，秋千有点像椅子，但它们没有靠背。

segments.en: So you sit down on a piece that's maybe plastic, and someone behind you will push you because you're on these hanging chairs.
segments.zh: 所以你坐在可能是塑料的片上，你身后的人会推你，因为你在这些吊椅上。

segments.en: And they'll push you, and you go forward and backward.
segments.zh: 他们会推你，你就会前后摆动。

segments.en: And you can go very, very high, and then you come back down.
segments.zh: 你可以荡得非常非常高，然后又会降下来。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So these are swings.
segments.zh: 所以这些就是秋千。

segments.en: All of this equipment you've most likely seen at any of the parks that are nearby.
segments.zh: 所有这些设备，你大概在附近任何公园都见过。

segments.en: But we're going to post some pictures as well so you can see more clearly what they're all about.
segments.zh: 但我们也将发布一些图片，以便您更清楚地了解它们的全部内容。

segments.en: Now, let's go and review the dialogue again before we move on to Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 现在，在我们继续使用流利表达之前，让我们再次回顾一下对话。

segments.en: Sounds like fun.
segments.zh: 听起来挺好玩。

segments.en: When we go, he always just likes to play in the sandbox.
segments.zh: 我带他去时，他总是只爱在沙坑里玩。

segments.en: Yeah, but today he was really hyper.
segments.zh: 是啊，不过他今天特别兴奋。

segments.en: He even got under the monkey bars.
segments.zh: 他甚至到了攀爬横梯下。

segments.en: And then he went on to go on the swings for half an hour.
segments.zh: 后来他又荡了半个小时秋千。

segments.en: I'm exhausted.
segments.zh: 我筋疲力尽。

segments.en: You should go to the park more often since you don't go to the gym anymore.
segments.zh: 你现在都不去健身房了，倒该多带他去公园活动。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We're back. So now let's take a look at three phrases on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 我们回来了。 所以现在让我们来看看关于流利表达的三个短语。

segments.en: So our first phrase today is actually something that the parent is talking about.
segments.zh: 所以我们今天的第一个短语实际上是父母正在谈论的事情。

segments.en: She wants to take Kenny to the park and get some fresh air.
segments.zh: 她想带肯尼去公园呼吸新鲜空气。

segments.en: Now, what does it mean to go get fresh air?
segments.zh: 现在，去呼吸新鲜空气是什么意思？

segments.en: Well, basically, it means to go out and maybe walk or just be outside and get air from the outside.
segments.zh: 好吧，基本上，这意味着出去走走，或者只是在外面从外面呼吸。

segments.en: Because sometimes you're in your house all the time, and that's not fresh air.
segments.zh: 因为有时你总是在你的房子里，那不是新鲜空气。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So basically, this means exactly what you're saying. It means going outside.
segments.zh: 所以基本上，这正是你说的意思。 就是到外面去。

segments.en: So kids often need to go get some fresh air, but also adults do, too.
segments.zh: 所以孩子们经常需要去呼吸新鲜空气，但成年人也需要去呼吸新鲜空气。

segments.en: Sometimes I feel like when I'm working in the office for a long time, I really need to get some fresh air.
segments.zh: 有时我觉得在办公室工作很长时间时，我真的需要呼吸一下新鲜空气。

segments.en: So that means I go outside for a walk.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着我出去散步。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And you can tell your friends, oh, excuse me for a minute.
segments.zh: 你可以告诉你的朋友，哦，对不起，请稍等。

segments.en: I'm going to go get some fresh air.
segments.zh: 我要去呼吸新鲜空气。

segments.en: Or you know what? You're looking a little bit pale.
segments.zh: 或者，你猜怎么着？ 你看起来有点苍白。

segments.en: Maybe you should go get some fresh air.
segments.zh: 也许你应该去呼吸新鲜空气。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And talking about all this great equipment and how much fun you can have, the wife said, wow, that sounds like fun.
segments.zh: 说到这些很棒的设备以及能玩得多开心，妻子说，哇，这听起来很好玩。

segments.en: Okay. So sounds like fun.
segments.zh: 好的。 所以听起来很有趣。

segments.en: It's not actually a sound.
segments.zh: 这实际上不是一个声音。

segments.en: This phrase is really important because we say it a lot, but it actually just means that it sounds like it will be a fun time.
segments.zh: 这句话真的很重要，因为我们说了很多，但它实际上只是意味着这听起来会是一段开心的时光。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Or I think it will be fun.
segments.zh: 或者我认为这会很有趣。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So from what you're telling me, I think it's fun.
segments.zh: 所以从你告诉我的情况来看，我认为这很有趣。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we can say this about a lot of things.
segments.zh: 所以这个说法可以用在很多事情上。

segments.en: I could say, hey, Marco, we're going to go play some football after work.
segments.zh: 我可以说，嘿，马可，我们下班后去踢足球。

segments.en: Do you want to come?
segments.zh: 你想来吗？

segments.en: Sure.
segments.zh: 当然。

segments.en: That sounds like fun.
segments.zh: 这听起来很有趣。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So he thinks it sounds like a good idea. He'll probably come, right?
segments.zh: 所以他认为这听起来是个好主意。 他可能会来，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly. So if something sounds like fun.
segments.zh: 没错。 所以，如果某件事听起来很有趣。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And moving on to our last phrase, we said that it was a great idea that we're going to the park and getting fresh air because we don't go to the gym anymore.
segments.zh: 继续我们的最后一句话，我们说我们去公园呼吸新鲜空气是个好主意，因为我们不再去健身房了。

segments.en: Okay. Now this is a really important phrase to keep as a phrase.
segments.zh: 好的。 现在这是一个非常重要的短语，可以作为一个短语。

segments.en: First of all, we have a gym.
segments.zh: 首先，我们有一个健身房。

segments.en: What do you do at a gym, Marco?
segments.zh: 你在健身房做什么，马可？

segments.en: Well, you work out.
segments.zh: 好吧，你锻炼了。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You exercise. Maybe you run on the treadmill or you lift weights.
segments.zh: 你锻炼。 也许你在跑步机上跑步，或者你举重。

segments.en: But it's important to remember that the verb here is to go to the gym.
segments.zh: 但重要的是要记住，这里的动词是去健身房。

segments.en: So I could say I go to the gym three times a week.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说我每周去健身房 3 次。

segments.en: How often do you go to the gym?
segments.zh: 你多久去一次健身房？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's the phrase.
segments.zh: 所以这就是短语。

segments.en: You go to the gym.
segments.zh: 你去健身房。

segments.en: I stop going to the gym and I gain a little weight.
segments.zh: 我停止去健身房，我的体重增加了一点。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's the way you use it.
segments.zh: 所以这就是你使用它的方式。

segments.en: You don't use any other verb when you're talking about the gym.
segments.zh: 当你谈论健身房时，你不使用任何其他动词。

segments.en: You say you go to the gym.
segments.zh: 你说你去健身房。

segments.en: I go to the gym.
segments.zh: 我去健身房。

segments.en: He goes to the gym regularly.
segments.zh: 他经常去健身房。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So that's all the Fluency Builder for today.
segments.zh: 所以这就是今天的流利表达。

segments.en: Let's review our dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 让我们最后一次回顾我们的对话。

segments.en: Hey, honey.
segments.zh: 嘿，亲爱的。

segments.en: Where were you?
segments.zh: 你去哪儿了？

segments.en: I decided to take Kenny to the park and get some fresh air.
segments.zh: 我带肯尼去公园透透气。

segments.en: How was it?
segments.zh: 怎么样？

segments.en: Were there a lot of kids?
segments.zh: 有很多孩子吗？

segments.en: It wasn't too crowded, but we had a great time.
segments.zh: 人不算多，不过我们玩得挺开心。

segments.en: We got on the seesaw together, then went on a couple of different slides, and then I tried to go with him in the jungle gym, but I didn't fit.
segments.zh: 我们一起玩了跷跷板，还玩了几种滑梯。我本想跟他一起钻攀爬架，可是身子太大，进不去。

segments.en: Sounds like fun.
segments.zh: 听起来挺好玩。

segments.en: When we go, he always just likes to play in the sandbox.
segments.zh: 我带他去时，他总是只爱在沙坑里玩。

segments.en: Yeah, but today he was really hyper.
segments.zh: 是啊，不过他今天特别兴奋。

segments.en: He even got under the monkey bars.
segments.zh: 他甚至到了攀爬横梯下。

segments.en: And then he went on to go on the swings for half an hour.
segments.zh: 后来他又荡了半个小时秋千。

segments.en: I'm exhausted.
segments.zh: 我筋疲力尽。

segments.en: You should go to the park more often since you don't go to the gym anymore.
segments.zh: 你现在都不去健身房了，倒该多带他去公园活动。

segments.en: All right. So growing up, there are many, many different games at parks that you can probably find, especially now you have such great playground equipment.
segments.zh: 好的。 从小到大，公园里有很多很多不同的游戏可以玩，尤其是现在游乐设备这么棒。

segments.en: But I think these are the most basic ones that everyone knows about.
segments.zh: 但我认为这些是每个人都知道的最基本的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: These are pretty standard things that you'll see at a playground.
segments.zh: 这些是您将在操场上看到的非常标准的东西。

segments.en: Remember that a park doesn't have to have these things.
segments.zh: 请记住，公园不必拥有这些东西。

segments.en: Parks are just public places, maybe with benches and trees.
segments.zh: 公园只是公共场所，也许有长凳和树木。

segments.en: But a playground is the part of the park where you'll see these kinds of things like a slide or swings.
segments.zh: 但游乐场是公园的一部分，您会看到这些东西，如滑梯或秋千。

segments.en: And so it's important to remember that they're not the same.
segments.zh: 所以重要的是要记住它们不一样。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And now, did you ever have a bad accident or did you fall off the swing or the seesaw or maybe you fell off the slide?
segments.zh: 现在，您是否曾发生过严重事故，或者您是否从秋千或跷跷板上摔下来，或者您从滑梯上掉下来了？

segments.en: Oh, I fell all the time.
segments.zh: 哦，我一直摔倒。

segments.en: Never a serious accident, but swings, I liked to swing.
segments.zh: 倒没出过什么严重的事故，不过秋千嘛，我喜欢荡秋千。

segments.en: And when I was forward, you know, up in the air, I used to let go and jump.
segments.zh: 当我向前时，你知道，在空中，我曾经放手跳跃。

segments.en: You would jump off the swing.
segments.zh: 你会跳下秋千。

segments.en: I would jump off the swing.
segments.zh: 我会跳下秋千。

segments.en: So when you're very high in the air, it feels like you're flying for a minute.
segments.zh: 所以当你在空中荡得很高时，会有一瞬间感觉像在飞。

segments.en: My mother hated it because she thought I was going to break my arms.
segments.zh: 我妈妈讨厌它，因为她认为我会折断我的手臂。

segments.en: But I loved it.
segments.zh: 但我喜欢它。

segments.en: It's great fun.
segments.zh: 这很有趣。

segments.en: And actually, we would really like to know, maybe you have some pictures that you can share with us of some specific playground equipment that we may have missed.
segments.zh: 实际上，我们真的很想知道，也许您有一些照片，您可以与我们分享一些我们可能错过的特定游乐场设备。

segments.en: There are a lot of things out there and maybe locally there are even some more fun things that we don't have.
segments.zh: 那里有很多东西，也许在当地还有一些我们没有的东西。

segments.en: So let us know what do playgrounds look like in your country.
segments.zh: 因此，让我们知道您所在国家/地区的游乐场是什么样的。

segments.en: We hope to see you at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们希望在 Englishpod.com 见到您。

segments.en: All right. We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 好的。 我们会在那里见到你们。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
